concept: High-End Botanical Field Guide meets Finance Control Room. Deep earthy tones optimized for outdoor glare, utilizing strict grid structures with high contrast.

font_pairings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-black text-[#1C1F1D]
font_pairings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-[#1C1F1D]

typography.rules: Never center headings unless necessary. Left-align for reading speed. Tabular nums for all financial data in IBM Plex Sans.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Control Room Grid. Strict hierarchy. Dense and compact data but with generous internal padding (p-6) in borders to prevent collision. Mobile-first stacking.

components.card: bg-white border border-[#DCD7CB] rounded-md shadow-sm hover:border-[#8C938F] transition-colors duration-200
components.button_primary: bg-[#2D4C3B] text-[#F5F4F0] rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-semibold hover:bg-[#1E3629] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-[#2D4C3B] transition-all
components.button_secondary: bg-[#E8E5DC] text-[#1C1F1D] rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-semibold hover:bg-[#DCD7CB] transition-all
components.input: w-full bg-white border border-[#DCD7CB] rounded-md px-4 py-3 text-[#1C1F1D] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#2D4C3B] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#2D4C3B] shadow-sm
components.header: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#F5F4F0]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#DCD7CB]
components.badge: bg-[#E8E5DC] text-[#2D4C3B] px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-bold tracking-wide

motion.list_stagger: staggered entrance for list items, minimal micro-interactions to preserve field usability.

icons.style: Use 'regular' weight for UI actions, 'duotone' weight for empty states or large decorative headers.

login_background.description: Minimalist landscape photograph of a serene goat farm at golden hour used for login page overlay
login_background.usage: Login Page Full Background. MUST use a gradient overlay (bg-black/30 or bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 to-transparent) to ensure form legibility.

dashboard_texture.usage: Optional top hero banner texture on the Dashboard or Reports page to add depth.

family_placeholder.usage: Decorative image for 'Goat Trading' category or empty states in transactions.

crop_placeholder.usage: Decorative image for 'Field Expenses' or 'Banana' category empty states.

accessibility.contrast: All text over background must meet 4.5:1 ratio. The UI operates in high-sunlight outdoor conditions; maximize contrast on data.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, form inputs, navigation links, and key financial summaries (e.g., data-testid='expense-submit-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first, highly legible dashboard optimized for field usability and outdoor glare.
Implement the UI using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn primitives (Card, Select, Dialog, Form).
Logic rule: When adding an expense, if 'Paid from: Own Pocket' is selected, automatically generate a corresponding 'Investment' record for that partner.
Do NOT use default 'tech blue' anywhere. Strictly adhere to the Earthy & Organic palette provided above.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for responsive structural grids (bento-style asymmetry where it makes sense), and Recharts or Shadcn Charts for data visualizations (Monthly Income/Expense).
For the login page, use the 'login_background' media URL as the full-screen background with a solid or glassmorphism form container.
Ensure the Transactions List has clear filters and prominent CSV/PDF export buttons.
Currency is ₹ INR (Indian Rupees). Format all monetary values clearly with tabular numbers.
